title: Connect two objects
summary: Spring Framework: Connect two objects. Change the Score value to 7.
introduction: Spring can pass one bean into another bean method. This is dependency injection: the object receives what it needs.
learningObjectives: Connect two objects with Spring Framework

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.

blocks.title: Connect two objects

blocks.text: Spring creates Score first and passes it to badge. The Badge method doubles its stored 4.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Declare the needed dependency instead of creating a second hidden copy.
